items.exchange_summary: HDFC Bank Limited has approved the re-appointment of Dr. Harsh Kumar Bhanwala, DIN 06417704, as an Independent Director for five years from January 25, 2027, to January 24, 2032. This decision was made by the Board of Directors on November 25, 2026, following the recommendation of the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee. items.subject: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Infosys Becomes the World s First Organization to Achieve CMMI AI Maturity (AIM) Level 5'.
items.exchange_summary: Infosys announced it is the world’s first organization to achieve CMMI AI Maturity Level 5. The assessment was conducted by Benchmarked Pty Ltd on November 25, 2026. The evaluation covered more than 1,000 projects globally. It examined AI governance, deployment, and performance. The recognition highlights Infosys’ use of Infosys Topaz and responsible AI governance. The company reports improved productivity and reduced costs. This information is filed with BSE Limited, National Stock Exchange of India Limited, and New York Stock Exchange.

items.subject: Suzlon Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
items.exchange_summary: Suzlon Energy Limited informs the exchange that the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister laid the foundation stone for its new one gigawatt smart blade manufacturing plant in Thoothukudi on 25th November 2026. This facility is Suzlon’s third plant in the state, complementing existing operations in Coimbatore. The proposed capacity is approximately 1,000 MW, with an investment of approximately Rs. 200 Crores funded through internal accruals. Construction is expected to be completed within approximately 12 months. The plant will manufacture blades up to 95 metres long for the S175 five megawatt turbine. It is projected to create over 1,000 jobs, with 80% of employment reserved for rural communities. The facility will be one of three AI-powered smart blade factories and will be 100% powered by renewable energy.

items.subject: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 142700 Non Convertible Securities at its meeting held on November 25, 2026
items.exchange_summary: Bajaj Finance Limited allotted 1,42,700 Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures on 25 November 2026. The face value is Rs. 1 Lakh per debenture, aggregating to Rs. 1440.7523 crore. The instrument carries an 8.70% annual coupon rate. The tenure is 1800 residual days, maturing on 30 October 2031. First coupon payment is scheduled for 30 October 2027, with subsequent annual payments on maturity. The debentures are proposed to be listed on the Wholesale Debt Market Segment of BSE Limited. The ISIN is RE-ISSUE - INE296A07UH6. Repayment is secured by a first pari-passu charge on book debts and loan receivables. The security cover shall not be less than 1.00 times the aggregate outstanding value of the debentures.

items.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
items.exchange_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the exchanges that S&P Global Ratings assigned a preliminary long-term issuer credit rating of BBB+ with a stable outlook to Sun Pharma Global Treasury Centre IFSC Limited. This indirect wholly owned subsidiary is considered a core entity equalized with its parent. The rating reflects the subsidiary's role in financing and treasury operations, particularly for the proposed acquisition of Organon and Co. Sun Pharma expects to complete this acquisition in the first quarter of 2027. The preliminary rating on the parent is subject to securing necessary approvals for the transaction and ensuring the pro forma capital structure remains neutral to the rating. S&P anticipates the debt to EBITDA ratio will improve to about 1.8x in fiscal 2028, versus net cash in fiscal 2026.

items.subject: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
items.exchange_summary: Titan Company Limited informed the exchanges on 23rd November 2026 that ICRA Ltd. has updated its credit ratings. The rating for the long term fixed deposit programme of Rs. 3,000 crore is reaffirmed as ICRA AAA with a stable outlook. For long term and short term fund based and non fund based working capital facilities, the rating is reaffirmed as ICRA AAA with a stable outlook and ICRA A1 plus. The limit for these facilities has been enhanced from Rs. 14,750 crore to Rs. 16,750 crore. The rating for long term fund based term loans of Rs. 1,000 crore is reaffirmed as ICRA AAA with a stable outlook. The total rated amount stands at Rs. 20,750 crore.

items.subject: Suzlon Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure with respect to cyber incident'.
items.exchange_summary: Suzlon Energy Limited disclosed a cyber incident on 23rd November 2026. The company took immediate action to mitigate impact and initiated precautionary response protocols. No impact has been observed on business-critical applications at this stage. The incident was reported to the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team. The company stated the event does not fall under Part A or Part B of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations but made the disclosure as a matter of prudence. Suzlon requested stakeholders to refrain from rumors and speculations. The company thanked customers, vendors, and team members for their support.

items.subject: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
items.exchange_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a large order for deploying an AI cluster. Its subsidiary LTN Compute will deploy additional NVIDIA B300 GPUs at its Chennai Data Center. This multi-year engagement supports an inference infrastructure provider. The deployment powers an AI-native platform for training and deploying specialized models. The initiative is part of a 10,000 GPU cluster. The Chennai campus is being developed as a gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure hub. Phase 1 is designed for 250 MW capacity. The order is classified as large, with a value between 2,500 and 5,000 crore rupees. The announcement was issued on November 23, 2026.

items.subject: Persistent Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Company Statement'.
items.exchange_summary: Persistent Systems Limited informs the exchange that a U.S.-based law firm handling its employee immigration matters may have experienced a cybersecurity incident, resulting in the purported exfiltration of certain employee immigration data and supporting documentation. The company states that its own systems are secure and business operations continue normally. Persistent Systems clarifies that claims regarding the theft of critical company information are unverified, as the law firm was not in possession of such data. This communication is filed for the information and record of the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited.

items.subject: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Price increase
items.exchange_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has increased prices of select models effective 22nd November 2026. The company cites sustained cost pressures as the reason for this decision. The estimated volume weighted average price increase is around 0.31 percent. Management states that despite cost reduction efforts, prevailing pressures necessitate passing a portion of the increase to the market. The goal is to minimize the impact on customers. This notice is filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary, issued the communication on 22nd November 2026.

The Asset Purchase Agreement was originally executed on 16th November 2026. This update is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. items.subject: Newspaper Advertisements about opening of Special Window for transfer of physical shares
items.exchange_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has published newspaper advertisements on 21 November 2026 regarding the opening of a Special Window for the transfer of physical shares. This window is open for a period of one year, from 05 February 2026 to 04 February 2027. It applies to shares sold or purchased prior to 01 April 2019. The facility also covers transfer requests previously rejected, returned, or not attended to due to deficiencies in documents or process. The advertisements were published in all editions of Financial Express in English and the Ahmedabad Edition of Financial Express in Gujarati. The company will also post information on social media platforms X, LinkedIn, and Facebook. items.subject: HDFC Bank Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
items.exchange_summary: HDFC Bank Limited reports that the Special Resolution for the re-appointment of Mrs. Lily Vadera, DIN 09400410, as an Independent Director has been passed with the requisite majority. The resolution was approved via postal ballot on Friday, November 20, 2026. Scrutinizer Mr. B. Narasimhan of M/s. BN & Associates confirmed the results. Out of 48,41,772 members holding shares as of the cut-off date of Friday, October 16, 2026, 12,114 members voted. The votes in favor accounted for 99.092 percent of valid votes cast, while votes against accounted for 0.908 percent. The e-voting period ran from Thursday, October 22, 2026, to Friday, November 20, 2026. The results are deemed passed on the last date of the e-voting period.
